raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (the 2026-01-18 delivery) writes amounts with a leading '$' (e.g. '$10.02'), while earlier batches are plain decimals, so CAST to DECIMAL(12,2) fails. Stripping the currency symbol before the cast normalizes the format; all rows are USD, so no currency conversion is needed, and the strict cast will still fail loudly on any other unexpected format.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
